## On-Call Handoff — Gateway 503s

**Status:** Ongoing at end of available logs (03:59:27Z) — not yet resolved.

**Impact window:** 2026-03-14 02:14:18Z → at least 03:59:27Z (~1h45m and counting). First failure: `req-07401 /v1/cart -> billing-svc 503`. Backlog has climbed the entire time — pool `waiting` count grew from 13 to 74 — so it's actively getting worse, not stabilizing.

**Scope:** Gateway only. Affects pool-gated routes (`/v1/cart`, `/v1/session`, `/v1/checkout`, `/v1/orders`, `/v1/catalog/search`) across all upstreams (billing-svc, orders-svc, catalog-svc, accounts-svc). `/health` unaffected (200s throughout, doesn't touch the pool). Workers (`logs/worker.log`) are clean — jobs finishing ok with normal db_wait times, no related errors. This is isolated to the gateway's connection pool.

**Root cause:** `dep-4471` (gateway, a.novak, 02:12:00–02:14:00Z) — *"config: connection-per-request for pool isolation."* Applied as config generation 119 at 02:13:41Z, flipping `gateway.pool.perRequest: false -> true` (also bumped `upstreamMs` timeout 2000→2500). Pool size stayed fixed at 20. First slow-acquire warning at 02:14:14Z, first 503 four seconds later at 02:14:18Z — the per-request connection change is what drove the pool to exhaust (`ERROR pool ... ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED acquiring connection from pool (size 20, in_use 20, waiting N)`).

**Action: roll back `dep-4471`** (gateway config generation 119 → 118, specifically revert `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `false`). No other deploy in `deploys.csv` is near the incident window (next one, `dep-4472`, doesn't start until 02:41Z, well after onset).

**Not related:** one `WARN` in worker.log at 02:36:22Z (slow unindexed query) — pre-flagged as known issue OPS-2210, unrelated to this incident.
